ValidationRule.description: Aggregate rows are outputs of aggregation, never inputs. Counting one would double-count everything beneath it.
ValidationRule.errorConditionFormula: AND( ISPICKVAL(Row_Type__c, "Group Header") || ISPICKVAL(Row_Type__c, "Subtotal") || ISPICKVAL(Row_Type__c, "Section Total") || ISPICKVAL(Row_Type__c, "Grand Total"), OR(Include_In_Subtotal__c, Include_In_Grand_Total__c) )
ValidationRule.errorMessage: Group Header, Subtotal, Section Total and Grand Total rows must have both inclusion flags cleared - they are the result of aggregation, not an input to it.
